summary: Brookfield Corporation filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, attaching a press release reporting Q2 2026 results. The release highlights a 15% increase in distributable earnings per share, fundraising totals of $98 billion, deployment of $100 billion, and monetization of $40 billion. It also notes strategic initiatives including the completed acquisition of Just Group in the U.K., completion of the Oaktree acquisition, and shareholder approval of a simplification transaction, alongside ongoing share repurchases. The filing is a routine earnings announcement, not a standalone special-situation event, despite referencing completed acquisitions and capital returns.
